details.report: Committed the two authorized receipt-evidence repairs. Removed the primitive Git-ID permutation matrices and retained one objectFormat/ID-width red-green cross-field tracer. Runtime settlement now projects typed per-leg materialization evidence from the ledger for successful and post-materialization failed outcomes; runner failure paths preserve completed evidence; receipt validation requires it for success and mechanically binds leg, manifest, complete canonical bundle entries, and verified read-back while allowing omission before materialization. Runtime paths remain confined to runtime-owned evidence. Regenerated tracked dist artifacts. Verification passed: focused receipt/settlement/agent/native-sealer tests, typecheck, isolated-HOME full suite (330 pass, 5 skip, 0 fail), package/cold-install lifecycle tests within the full suite, prepack, npm pack --dry-run, and git diff --check. No findings were left unaddressed.
